main_integration_review.scope: Main independently checked every recorded term and keyword page location within actual chapter regions, visually reviewed mixed-page boundaries, spot-checked typography, and reviewed every cue and reuse target. Draft-pending notes below are historical and superseded by this section. AI review, not clinical, legal, human-expert, empirical recall or image validation.
main_integration_review.normalizations: Joined line-wrap hyphens and title punctuation; omitted trademark glyph in Shiley. Explicit shared-word expansions: patient and family wishes; spiritual, psychosocial, and educational support; recovery of organs for transplantation; Disrupted or Distorted airway. Not all are contiguous quotations.
